name: Memberra
description: Securely connect Jellyfin to the Memberra operator platform.
overview: Pair a Jellyfin server with Memberra for health reporting, event delivery and managed operator workflows.

versions.changelog: Adds safe operator-side account renaming and administrator-aware inventory for Memberra's unified Media Account Control Centre.
Adds authoritative Jellyfin user inventory so Memberra can discover every current account and reconcile removed accounts accurately.
Fixes untappable remote-stop and viewer-message controls on mobile Jellyfin dashboards while preserving all 1.3 provisioning, recovery and telemetry capabilities.
Plugin-native provisioning, suspension, restoration, deletion, password reset, library scoping and secure poster transfer, while retaining durable outbox recovery and viewer controls.
Capability-gated messages to active Jellyfin players, with bounded content, active-session validation, durable command receipts and operator-controlled opt-in.
Durable ordered event delivery, outage and restart recovery, active-session reconciliation, explicit protocol and capability negotiation, queue diagnostics, and compatibility-first fail-safes.
Production release for Jellyfin 10.11.x with fixed-endpoint transport hardening, bounded playback state, replay-safe event ingestion and live watch analytics.
